fix_subject: When doing an indexed row-value comparison using an IN operator where the order of the columns in the row-value need to be rearranged in order to match the index, be sure to make affinity conversions before the rearranging of columns so that the correct affinity is applied.  Fix for the bug reported by [forum:/forumpost/eab63506cf|forum post eab63506cf].  This problem goes back almost nine years to [ddb5f0558c445699].
